requestsKept: The backend keeps this count in its data directory. All users see the same count.
requestsMemory: The backend keeps this count only in memory and starts over when it restarts. All users see the same count.
perfHint: While it is off, OMV records no performance graphs. Statistics already recorded are kept.
configDirty: OMV has changes that are not applied yet. Apply or revert them in the OMV workbench first.
backendDown: Could not connect to the backend. Check that the backend is running.
